units.source_text: 不知过了多少天，她猛然清醒过来的时候，已经舒适地躺在游艇里，安详地漫游在尼罗河上。

en.t: She did not know how many days had passed, but when she suddenly came to, she was already lying comfortably inside a yacht, drifting peacefully along the Nile.

units.source_text: 身旁有位英国医生侍候着。

en.t: An English doctor was attending her at her side.

units.source_text: 游艇是那个青年拥有的。

en.t: The yacht belonged to that young man.

units.source_text: 她在青年的陪伴下，返回了首都开罗。

en.t: Accompanied by the young man, she returned to the capital, Cairo.

units.source_text: 在他家疗养期间，她从心底对青年的家人产生了一种亲切感。

en.t: While recuperating at his home, she came to feel a sincere affection for the young man's family.

units.source_text: 不觉间，两人萌生了恋情。

en.t: Before they knew it, love had begun to grow between them.

units.source_text: 数月后，青年终于向她求婚。

en.t: Several months later, the young man finally proposed to her.
